contentText: The Super Eagles and the Pharaohs have booked the last spots left to get a chance at lifting the Africa Cup of Nations trophy in Morocco. Nigeria's flawless performance saw them crush Algeria who couldn't find a way into the game and were forced to sit back and soften the blows. Egypt meanwhile were able to edge past Ivory Coast 3-2 as the Elephants attempted a comeback in one of the most exciting games of the tournament so far.
